subject: Re: ES-ENAS kickoff: compact RL controllers without extra cost
body:
Anders,

Staffing for the window: Rosa 60% on the gRPC comms layer and worker fleet (she did the equivalent on the ES-MAML open-source path, so she knows the aggregator/worker pattern cold), Bilal 50% supporting her on deployment configs, Freya 70% on the search-space work, Quentin 40% on benchmark environments.

Compute: ES is embarrassingly parallel and CPU-heavy - we need worker fleet capacity, not GPUs. I've sized it at 2,000 concurrent CPU workers on the batch tier for the March benchmark sweeps; the controller itself is tiny.

One dependency to note: the topology controller in the release leans on a proposal-generation library that isn't open-sourced yet, so Freya is treating the code as a template and swapping in our internal evolutionary controller for suggest/feedback. That's a real chunk of her March.

Feb 27 comms milestone looks safe - Rosa has the proto definitions drafted already.

Santiago
